tagline.en: The image-to-video route of VideoCrafter1 — animate a still image into a short generated clip.
tagline.zh: VideoCrafter1 的图生视频路径——把一张静态图片生成为一段短视频。

en: VideoCrafter1 I2V is the image-to-video path of the open-source VideoCrafter family. It takes a still image as the starting frame and generates motion from it, producing a short video clip.

It runs as an inference-only route wrapping the official VideoCrafter image-to-video pipeline, using the Image2Video checkpoint. There's no training or download tooling bundled — it's set up purely for generation.
In WorldFoundry you provide the input image and set frame count, fps, and seed; the shared pipeline handles loading and writes out the resulting video.
zh: VideoCrafter1 I2V 是开源 VideoCrafter 家族的图生视频路径。它以一张静态图片为起始帧,从中生成运动,产出一段短视频片段。
它以推理路径运行,封装官方 VideoCrafter 图生视频流程,使用 Image2Video checkpoint。其中不附带训练或下载工具——它纯粹面向生成。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你提供输入图片并设定帧数、fps 与随机种子;统一 pipeline 负责加载并输出最终视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you have a starting image and want VideoCrafter1 to bring it into motion as a short clip.
whenToUse.zh: 当你有一张起始图片,想用 VideoCrafter1 让它动起来、生成一段短片时使用它。

notFor.en: Not for text-only generation (use the text-to-video route) and not for training. Checkpoint licensing isn't stated, so verify terms before commercial use.
notFor.zh: 不适合纯文本生成(请用文生视频路径),也不用于训练。该 checkpoint 未标明许可,商用前请核实条款。
